tests.scope: Artificial scores and renderer stubs; no model inference or bootstrap.

observations: Labels, legends and notes fit without overlap or clipping.
All four pooled panels share a horizontal scale; source contrasts share a symmetric scale around zero.
Both training seeds remain visible; empty filtered source has text and no zero-valued point.
Synthetic fixture warning is prominent. Fixture images remain private, outside public artifacts.

real_gate.refusal: Complete BabyLM evaluation artifacts are required

limitations: No official BabyLM result plot exists yet. Actual-value layouts must be visually reviewed after complete held-out evaluation.
Component differences are descriptive; no component confidence intervals are generated.
Renderer does not restore weights, compute new likelihoods, or rerun bootstrap intervals.
